preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.
There must be exactly n - 1 edges to form a valid tree.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(dominant_index, int) and dominant_index >= 0 for dominant_index in output)
postconditions.description: Each dominant index in the output must be a non-negative integer.
The output must contain exactly n dominant indices corresponding to each vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(dominant_index <= n - 1 for dominant_index in output)
postconditions.description: Each dominant index must be less than or equal to n - 1.
